verdict.rationale: AiPrise is an AI-powered compliance platform whose automated agents review websites and adjudicate screening alerts, so letting users connect MCP servers to extend those agents is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP, plugging in external tool servers, or any extensible agent tool interface. The llms.txt and docs.md probes only show machine-readable documentation, which is a different capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
